A mysterious social media user claiming to be a 'time traveler from the year 2609' has made a series of bold predictions about the future

02:00 ET, 12 Oct 2026Updated 04:50 ET, 12 Oct 2026

A mysterious social media personality, who claims to be a "time traveler from the year 2609", has issued startling predictions about when " robots will take over" our planet. The puzzling figure known as 'Aqua Traveller', posting as @aqua_time_traveller, has attracted more than 1,800 followers by delivering ominous forecasts about what lies ahead - from the unveiling of undiscovered planets to devastating environmental catastrophes.

‌

In their disclosure, the supposed time traveler claims to have knowledge of several major forthcoming events - including the exact moment when machines will rise up against humanity.

Solar system's end coming sooner than we thought, the glorious smell of rain in peril, insomnia will kill you, an alligator wearing a toupée, and did the Martians nuke themselves? All this and more in our weird science newsletter

‌

The footage, which has garnered over 2,700 views, reveals: "These big events and their dates... February 17, 2103, robots are officially going to take over the world."

TikTok viewers were baffled as they rushed to the comments to voice their confusion and weigh in on the disturbing forecast.

One noted: "February 17 is my birthday but the year..", reports the Daily Star. Another user simply replied: "Yeah, definitely." A third added: "Totally."

‌

Yet other viewers were especially unsettled by a different prediction featured in the video, which stated that " dogs will be extinct on 9 December 2046."

One distressed commenter said: "The dog one has to be fake." Another posted: "I don't believe. "Ok, how are dogs gonna go extinct?" a third queried.

‌

This follows another "time traveller from 2671" who claimed that parents will gain the capability to genetically engineer their children before 2023 ends.

Eno Alaric, posting under the username @theradianttimetraveller, has accumulated more than 26,000 followers by posting alerts about supposed future events.

The social media personality has previously issued advisories about twin planets orbiting near Earth, alien contact and even portals leading to parallel universes.

However, the self-described time-hopper has now announced that parents are just months away from choosing superior genes for their children to prevent inherited diseases and even select their appearance.
